notes: This book by Julia Cook teaches impulse control and turn-taking in conversation. The central metaphor is that Louis's thoughts 'erupt' like a volcano when he interrupts. Key vocabulary centres on social communication skills: waiting, listening, raising your hand, and taking turns. 'Erupt' is best represented by the volcano image already in activity_images. 'Feelings' is included because the book explicitly addresses why Louis feels compelled to blurt out — emotional literacy is a core theme. The word 'interrupt' may need to be sourced as a custom image (person tapping another on shoulder / speech bubble cutting in) as Boardmaker coverage varies. Secondary characters (classmates, teacher) are generic and do not need sourcing.
